status: exploratory reuse of the original test and Korean splits; normalized concat is post-hoc after observing original concat; no normalization tuning
context_boundary: A/B is an externally supplied oracle task context; the system does not infer context
mechanism_boundary: input gating and engine routing are engineered and are not a biological compartment model

protocol.reward: +1 only for the actually sampled correct action, otherwise -1; no teacher action update
protocol.normalized_control_timing: exact unit-L2 normalization, unchanged seeds, parameters, and schedule were fixed before the control run, but the control was not preregistered

modular.note: twice the engine parameters; trusted context routes to separate engines

concat_normalized.note: post-hoc exploratory control added after observing the original concat result; normalization strength was fixed exactly at unit norm

initialization: all engines load the same frozen pn_kc.tsv and kc_mbon.tsv connectome; modular A/B engines begin as identical copies
comparison_boundary: architectures change port routing as well as context availability; results do not identify a causal effect of context alone
